final_comparison: Both arms were freshly decompiled from main889c; no earlier output or timing was reused.
parser_only_policy: Original Rust runtime bodies contain invalid in(...) calls and _:: namespace prefixes. The independent parser makes identical counted repairs on both sides; original emitted text is untouched. All remaining AST fields, comments and original casts must match.

source_mapping_policy: All old addresses are retained, and newly exposed addresses are within the pre-existing recovered extent and decode as original machine instructions. Three old recovered bodies extend outside their symbols, so symbol size alone is not a valid bound.
main_integration: All 42 records changed by main1407 on each arm differ only by consistent bijective generated-struct renaming; every other function field is identical. This is independent of the extension correction.
